title: Pause Cloud Sync writes
summary: The confirmation for the platform's one Cloud Sync kill switch (cloudSync.writesPaused), opened from Diceroll's Cloud Sync page: it names every product the pause stops, what their people see, that nothing is deleted, takes a required reason and confirms with a passkey.
compare: The dialog opens over the Cloud Sync page with the page dimmed behind; it is the only way to turn the switch on. The paused state that follows is config.cloud-sync-paused.
The title asks with its scope: "Pause Cloud Sync writes everywhere?", because writesPaused is a platform setting even when opened from one product.

Every product with Cloud Sync on is listed by logo and name with what stops, what its people see and how many have data: one fact per line: DJDL "Settings wait on each Mac and PC." / "Each shows “Waiting to sync”." / "No one has synced yet."; Diceroll "Saves and settings wait on each device." / "Each shows “Saved on this device”." / "4,812 players have data." Products with Cloud Sync off aren't listed.
The body says what keeps working (reading), that nothing is deleted, and what happens on resume (devices send what they queued).
Reason is required, with a hint under it saying where it shows (the banner and Activity); the passkey step-up is announced before the button.
The confirm button says exactly what happens and to how many: "Pause writes for 2 products", in the danger tone; Cancel is neutral.
The screen is one viewport behind the dialog. Phone: the dialog fills the width under the top bar, product rows keep logo and text side by side, and the buttons fill the width.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: the paused state and the way back are designed, the title fits, and every row says what people see.

findings.issue: After the dialog the platform kill switch was on but the paused state, its banner, Home and Resume were designed nowhere.
findings.resolution: Added config.cloud-sync-paused: a warning banner with who, when and the reason, Resume writes as its primary, and the switch on with "Paused 12 min". Its compare list specifies the resume toast ("Writes resumed. Devices are sending what they queued."), the same banner on every product's Cloud Sync page, and the platform Home's Needs attention row; that Home row belongs to products.home, another designer's screen, so it goes to the lead to route.

findings.issue: At 480px the title left "product?" alone on a line.
Rows didn't say what players see, the tense differed, and Reason was optional.
findings.resolution: DJDL: "Settings changes wait on each Mac and PC; the app shows Waiting to sync. No one has synced yet." Diceroll: "Saves and settings wait on each device; the load screen shows Saved on this device. 4,812 players have data." Reason is required and says it appears in the banner and Activity. The page behind is the fixed config.cloud-sync, clipped to one viewport.

findings.issue: The dialog repeated itself and the footer pattern differed on phone.
findings.resolution: Scope stated once in the title; one intro sentence; one closing line "Reading keeps working; nothing is deleted."; removed "Next, you confirm with your passkey" and put a fingerprint icon on the confirm button; footer is Cancel left, primary right, 44px side by side on phone (.kit-cfg).

findings.issue: Neutral primary on dialog commit buttons (UX4)
findings.resolution: declined: Contradicts the kit's accent system. Red for destructive and the service accent for service actions are deliberate.
